verses.translation: What are they asking one another about
About the momentous news
over which they disagree
But no! They will come to know
Again, no! They will come to know
Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺
and ˹made˺ the mountains as ˹its˺ pegs
and created you in pairs
and made your sleep for rest
and made the night as a cover
and made the day for livelihood
and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺
and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp
and sent down from rainclouds pouring water
producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants
and dense orchards
Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
verses.transliteration: Yawma yunfakhu fī ṣ-ṣūri fatatūna afwājan
verses.translation: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds
The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates
and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage
Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush
as a home for the transgressors
where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages

verses.arabicText: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.translation: There they will not taste any coolness or drink
except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—
a fitting reward
For they never expected any reckoning
and totally rejected Our signs
And We have everything recorded precisely
˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”
Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—
Gardens, vineyards
and full-bosomed maidens of equal age
and full cups ˹of pure wine˺

verses.arabicText: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
verses.translation: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—
a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord

verses.arabicText: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
verses.transliteration: Rabbi s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā r-raḥmāni lā yamlikūna min'hu khiṭāban
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
verses.transliteration: Yawma yaqūmu r-rūḥu wal-malāikatu ṣaffal-lā yatakallamūna illā man adhina lahu r-raḥmānu waqāla ṣawāban
verses.translation: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true

verses.arabicText: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.transliteration: Dhālika l-yawmu l-ḥaqu faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi maāban
verses.translation: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
verses.transliteration: Innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarībay-yawma yanẓuru l-maru mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu l-kāfiru yālaytanī kuntu turāban
verses.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
